answer.justification: Excessive, difficult-to-control worries about health and finances have persisted for 7 months. Associated irritability, tension, inattention, and insomnia satisfy additional generalized anxiety disorder criteria and cause functional distress. No stressor supports adjustment disorder, and social anxiety or normal worry would not explain this pervasive syndrome.
